english.title: Worker knowingly deliver on relevant premises alcohol to under 18
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a person who worked in a capacity whether paid or unpaid, on relevant premises, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES AND LOCATION..), knowingly delivered to **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), an individual under the age of 18, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AGE..), alcohol, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ALCOHOL..), sold on those premises
english.legislation: Contrary to section 151(1)(a) and (7) of the Licensing Act 2003.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being a person who worked in a capacity whether paid/unpaid on relevant premises
knowingly delivered to an individual under the age of 18 alcohol

english.notes:
As from 08/04/2013 Penalty Notices for Disorder may ONLY be issued to offenders aged 18 years or over.

This offence may be disposed of by the issue of a Penalty Notice for Disorder - DA21

(i) The Penalty Notice for Disorder rose from £80 to £90 on 01/07/13
(ii) Section 151(6) of the Licensing Act 2003 provides that the above offence does not apply where:-
(a) the alcohol is delivered at a place where the buyer or, as the case may be, person supplied lives or works, or
(b) the individual aged under 18 works on the relevant premises in a capacity, whether paid or unpaid, which involves the delivery of alcohol, or
(c) the alcohol is sold or supplied for consumption on the relevant premises.
(iii) For the similar offence relating to club premises see H5503
